title: How many ways can a Rubik's cube be mixed up?
subtitle: Guess how many ways a Rubik's cube can be mixed up, on a scale of powers of ten, then learn why every mess is at most twenty moves from solved.
notes: Republished 2026-10-04: the scale draws its own word ticks (1000, million … sextillion) — dropped the hidden tick numbers and the hand-drawn names; no global text scale (it crowded the ticks); affirm playful. check still warns that the '1 quadrillion'/'1 quintillion' tick words touch (they read fine in frames). Isometric cube from 27 filled paths.
